rationale: Under FAA regulatory framework (14 CFR Part 21 Subpart O), a TSO authorization is solely a design and production approval for an article to meet specified minimum performance standards. FAA guidance explicitly states that receiving a TSO authorization does not grant approval to install and use the article in an aircraft, which separately requires type certification, supplemental type certification, or airworthiness alteration approvals.
limitations: Review limited to US civil aviation statutory and regulatory frameworks (FAA 14 CFR Part 21); does not evaluate military airworthiness authorities or non-US civil aviation jurisdictions (e.g., EASA ETSO processes).
